stdout:
Issue #18 stands alone; duplicate_of: null. Verdict: easy-call.

The code-level claim is supported at upstream 3f7f4394923048a09dc2ecdcc53f79a0067a9fc7: CollectionFetchPaginationQueryTransformer rebuilds the inner selection list using primaryEntity.forEachSelectable(), which AbstractEntityPersister implements over attributeMappings, excluding subtype-declared attributes. The original outer selections are preserved and the root alias is excluded from absorption, so missing root-table subtype columns cannot be recovered there. AbstractEntityPersister.visitSubTypeAttributeMappings visits the current attributes plus subtype-declared attributes and provides a narrow existing traversal seam.

This is a two-way, localized hibernate-core SQL-generation correction, not a public API or schema change. Retain explicit identifier/discriminator/version selection and the projector's primary-table filter and deduplication. Check subtype traversal rather than redesigning absorption. Relevant tests are CollectionFetchPaginationAdvancedTest (joined inheritance), CollectionFetchPaginationFormulaTest and the pagination suite. A dedicated SINGLE_TABLE regression should cover the reported nested source/tags fetch, limit-two page, nonzero offset, limit-one ID lookup, complete collections and subclass values; disable plan caching and retain unlimited/in-memory controls. Include subtype formula behavior and inherited state if the test model can do so narrowly.

Difficulty: small production change with moderate regression verification. No duplicate was identified in the reconciled work queue or related PRs. Nearby formula and cache-plan issues require different changes. The target snapshot has neither CONTEXT.md nor .sandcastle/CODING_STANDARDS.md; current CONTRIBUTING.md and canonical Sandcastle review guidance were read. No compilation or test has run during this read-only triage. Current-main RED, then focused JDK25/H2 GREEN and formatChecks, remain mandatory before accepting the fix; historical reported database failures are not new verification.
